metricProfile.fourFinger: exact-time deduplicated heads within own measured candidates +/-20ms; baseline identity retention is diagnostic only; zero baseline count requires valid nonempty after chart when count gate enabled
metricProfile.uncertainty: Conditional fixed-systematic-subset description, not proof of song/artist/population independence.

bootstrap.method: paired within-genre percentile bootstrap; conditional on fixed ten genres
